answer: An admission auction stops fake identities by selling 200 slots per epoch. Each applicant files one sealed bid; the 200th bid sets the clearing price, which winners pay and the network burns. A copper badge binds payment to one record of past work, and an onyx seal on the slot cannot be transferred. The delta is stark: 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 x 400 = 400,000 credits, all burned, while one honest agent pays 400 once and keeps its reward undiluted.
